name: xero-budget-vs-actual-variance
description: Use for Xero questions like "are we on budget in Xero", "how did we do against budget last month", "which costs are over budget", "budget vs actual in Xero", "where are we year to date against plan", "will we hit the annual budget", or a monthly variance review — even when the user never says "variance". Use when the decision is which lines are off plan, by how much, and whether the full year still lands. Needs a budget entered in Xero. Xero only; for QuickBooks use quickbooks-budget-vs-actual-variance.
